theorems.name: Submission.dgoj_det_adjoint_comp_eq_det_sq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ τ → (∀ j, F (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ)) → (F.adjoint ∘L F).det = (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (τ i) (F (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))).det ^ 2
